---
mode: agent
description: Reconcile implementation progress against repository evidence.
---

Use the `implementation-progress` skill.

Inspect the approved plan, task board, progress log, current branch/diff, tests, CI and review evidence. Reconcile statuses only where evidence supports a change. Update the task board and append a progress-log entry. Report progress counts and calculation method, blockers, requirement gaps, risks and the next recommended task. Do not start implementation.
